acceptance: Promotion is crash-consistent, verifies all artifact digests and rejects partial or mismatched manifests.

positive.fixture: history m1, m2, branch, m3, rollback promotes in order; every head verifies whole
positive.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-versioning --test api; go -C backend test -tags integration -race -count=1 ./versions/

negative.fixture: missing, resized and swapped artifacts, cut and edited manifests, crash at blobs, manifest, intent and pointer, recovery over a deleted artifact
negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-versioning --test api; go -C backend test -tags integration -race -count=1 ./versions/

security_and_source_permissions: A head only ever names a complete manifest; Rust alone decides trust.
known_limitations: One process per store; no distributed promotion
